summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 3.9 Scientific Notation: Write numbers in standard or scientific notation.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "3.9 Scientific Notation", prints these objectives: "Write numbers in standard or scientific notation."
